groups.title: Applicable requirements and policy precedence
groups.prior_reason: The counted contribution repeats the same algorithm-choice check used by RG-018 and RG-019. It does not establish aggregate compliance or resolve actual policy conflicts.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Validated configuration and component modification
groups.prior_reason: The missing fact is whether a real product configuration matches an authoritative evaluated configuration. A proof over self-declared approval flags would add no authority.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Product eligibility on the CSfC Components List
groups.prior_reason: Product eligibility comes from an official listing for the exact model and version. Membership checking is straightforward once the identity and list are trustworthy.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Independent product, operating-system, and cryptographic implementations
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution compares four recorded OS families. Manufacturer, OS, and library diversity are inventory relationships that a complete checker can enumerate.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Physical separation of security components
groups.prior_reason: The proved clause compares hardware identities for role pairs. Pairwise disjointness is a direct inventory check; the difficult question is whether those identities denote the actual physical devices.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Product Supply Chain Threat Assessment
groups.prior_reason: Supply-chain assessment and AO approval are decisions made by accountable organizations. A theorem over a recorded approval does not establish that the assessment was adequate.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Two independent encryption layers and allowed tunnel pairings
groups.prior_reason: Protection depends on the combined effects of routing, filtering, encapsulation, encryption, decryption, and transmission. Testing selected packets leaves other modeled executions unexplored.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification has a reviewed general proof and checked applications under the recorded assumptions.

groups.title: Connectivity restricted to the same security level
groups.prior_reason: Cross-level isolation is a claim about every possible modeled delivery, including paths through shared infrastructure. A few failed pings cannot exclude another permitted route or packet shape.
groups.new_validation_claim: The two-level baseline satisfies RG-008. The four-level shared deployment preserves security levels but violates physical separation for an included unclassified network. Lean checked four baseline and eight shared directed paths. Its separate induction covers every admitted finite forwarding trace.
groups.profile_summary: The two-level baseline satisfies RG-008. The four-level shared deployment preserves security levels but violates physical separation for an included unclassified network.

groups.title: Gray-network control and classification boundary
groups.prior_reason: Network ownership and the classification of exposed Gray information require authoritative judgments. Network observations cannot decide those judgments.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Independently managed site administration and trust
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution checks that the peer's issuer appears in the loaded CA inventory. Set inclusion is straightforward and does not establish independent administration or traffic confinement.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Central management, CA placement, and intersite protection
groups.prior_reason: The counted contribution is a DROP default on two management forwarding chains. Generic firewall interpretation can check that configuration without a new central-management theory.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Separate authentication and management for security levels
groups.prior_reason: Different certificate or key identifiers alone do not establish that cross-level peers cannot authenticate. The trust rules must connect credentials, accepted identities, and security domains.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check the trust and management assignments for each level. Cross-level peer isolation also contributes to RG-008.

groups.title: Gray Firewalls on all paths needing level separation
groups.prior_reason: A firewall can appear in a diagram while another path bypasses it. The useful claim excludes every firewall-free crossing between the relevant endpoints.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification is proved under its recorded model and explicit assumptions.

groups.title: Gray addressing supports security-level filtering
groups.prior_reason: Address validity and disjointness are simple checks. The valuable step connects those checks to the behavior of all modeled accepted packets, including the interpretation of source and destination rules.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check Gray address ownership and intended peers. The active Gray interface and firewall proofs use the relevant address constraints.

groups.title: MACsec encapsulation and standalone encapsulator obligations
groups.prior_reason: Nested MACsec, carrier encapsulation, and Outer protection can be applied in the wrong order or remove a protection layer early. End-to-end composition has more cases than one successful exchange.
groups.new_validation_claim: Record the carrier configuration and applicable standalone-device duties. Retain encapsulation semantics used by the selected packet proofs.

groups.title: Permitted MACsec clear VLAN tags and XPN
groups.prior_reason: The current result verifies that enabled clear-VLAN and XPN features have recorded support. Feature support and enablement form a finite configuration matrix.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Mutual authentication and Non-Person Entity certificates
groups.prior_reason: The inspected proof derives both verification flags from an acceptance definition that requires those flags. Its main assurance burden is the assumed link to the real verifier; the added Boolean reasoning is small.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: CNSS algorithm-policy requirements and choices
groups.prior_reason: The counted result checks that configured offers belong to a prescribed algorithm set. Exact algorithm and parameter comparison is an ordinary exhaustive configuration check.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: IPsec CNSA profile and post-quantum exchange sequence
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution reuses RG-018's CNSA1 offer check. Recounting that check under a broader exchange-sequence requirement adds little assurance.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: VPN certificate loading and authentication checks
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution establishes distinct loaded certificate fingerprints. Duplicate detection is easy; the whole RG also contains substantially stronger authentication duties.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: VPN private-key access confinement
groups.prior_reason: The access-control result ranges over arbitrary callers and methods. A shared authorization proof can exclude a forbidden response across that input space.
groups.new_validation_claim: Assess key access at the deployed key store and its exposed interfaces.

groups.title: IKEv2 and IKE/ESP encryption-mode alternatives
groups.prior_reason: IKE version and encryption-mode selection are explicit configuration and negotiated-state fields. The current theorem adds no reasoning about packet execution.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: VPN SA lifetimes and reauthentication
groups.prior_reason: The current theorem combines a checked hard lifetime with the premise that an active SA's age is below that lifetime. The substantive timer-enforcement behavior is supplied by the premise.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: MACsec authentication alternatives and AS scope
groups.prior_reason: The selected result covers how CAK participants can be created through repeated protocol steps. One successful EAP exchange does not exclude another key-creation path.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check the authentication method, server attachment and peer-to-key evidence for the selected MACsec implementation.

groups.title: MACsec encryption and key wrapping algorithms
groups.prior_reason: AES key-wrap and MACsec cipher selection are named algorithms with key-size fields. A configuration/state comparison establishes the currently claimed fact.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: MACsec EAP-TLS CNSA profile alternatives
groups.prior_reason: The current result compares negotiated EAP-TLS suite fields with the selected profile. A complete field checker and negotiation tests give the same observed result.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: MACsec key generation, key-server selection, and rollover
groups.prior_reason: A disabled fallback setting matters only if all modeled participant-creation and renewal paths preserve that restriction. The current general invariant covers repeated actions.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check key-server priorities, key-name length, fallback settings and approved provisioning records.

groups.title: MACsec mandatory protection parameters
groups.prior_reason: The must-secure claim quantifies over emitted frames. Configuration inspection alone cannot show that every modeled send path requires protection.
groups.new_validation_claim: Inspect MACsec settings and check the protected transmission paths where the selected boundary proofs use them.

groups.title: Inner encryption and decryption cannot be bypassed
groups.prior_reason: Bypass can arise from alternative routes or processing branches. The useful guarantee covers every modeled traversal through the Inner boundary.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification has a reviewed general proof and checked applications under the recorded assumptions.

groups.title: Outer encryption and decryption cannot be bypassed
groups.prior_reason: The Outer boundary combines protected data and expressly permitted control traffic. Correctness depends on every modeled route through that boundary and the classification of exceptions.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification has a reviewed general proof and checked applications under the recorded assumptions.

groups.title: Routing and switching limits on Encryption Components
groups.prior_reason: The counted claim interprets a captured process inventory as showing no routing-protocol service. Lean adds little to a complete process/service/configuration audit, and still trusts the capture and program meanings.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: TRANSEC under the stated deployment conditions
groups.prior_reason: The selected cover-traffic mechanism has queue and emission behavior under varying arrivals and failed sends. A reusable invariant covers combinations that sample traces cannot exhaust.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check whether TRANSEC applies and whether the selected mechanism is active.

groups.title: Packet sizing to control fragmentation
groups.prior_reason: Nested encryption and carrier headers change size at different stages. Reading one MTU cannot establish that every permitted source size fits all relevant interfaces.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check packet sizing against the selected links and encapsulation overhead. Retain size and encoding facts needed by the active packet proofs.

groups.title: Outer Firewall placement for untrusted Black transport
groups.prior_reason: The required Outer Firewall must separate the Outer encryptor from untrusted Black transport on every relevant path. Local attachment inspection can miss a bypass.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification is proved under its recorded model and explicit assumptions.

groups.title: Permitted protocols and peers at encryption and firewall boundaries
groups.prior_reason: Allowed traffic depends on ordered rules, direction, protocol, endpoint identity, and exceptions. Example packets cannot exhaust those combinations.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification is proved under its recorded model and explicit assumptions.

groups.title: Minimal network-interface exposure
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution checks that 42 identified unused interfaces are down. A complete interface-status checker establishes that finite fact directly.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Outer-component third-party contact restrictions
groups.prior_reason: Third-party contact blocking ranges over destinations and locally generated requests. A permitted peer can work while a different destination remains accidentally reachable.
groups.new_validation_claim: Inventory third-party features and check the selected disabling or outbound blocking policy.

groups.title: IP header and multicast filtering
groups.prior_reason: Header checks interact with parser interpretation, IPv6 extension headers, multicast, and fragmentation order. A handful of captures can miss an alternate header form.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification is proved under its recorded model and explicit assumptions.

groups.title: Outer Gray-interface allowlist and default denial
groups.prior_reason: An allowlist combines same-level peer constraints with management, control, and revocation exceptions. An unintended union of allowances can admit prohibited traffic.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification is proved under its recorded model and explicit assumptions.

groups.title: Gray Firewall allowlist and cross-level denial
groups.prior_reason: Cross-level denial is an exhaustive packet-policy claim. Testing selected address pairs cannot establish denial for every packet admitted by ordered rules.
groups.new_validation_claim: Every clause of the instantiated specification is proved under its recorded model and explicit assumptions.

groups.title: Control-plane approval, defaults, and service location
groups.prior_reason: The current proof checks a time-source attachment to a bridge. Location, enabled-protocol lists, and AO permission records are primarily inventory and policy checks.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Layer-specific trusted time synchronization
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution establishes the location of a selected time source. It does not prove continuous synchronization or trustworthiness.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Default credentials, DNS, and remote bootstrap
groups.prior_reason: The counted DNS result is a selected deny policy for conventional DNS. The existing generic filter checker can certify that case; the RG does not justify a separate DNS execution theory.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Layer-specific administration and management-plane separation
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution checks ten AW assignments for cross-layer sharing. Assignment disjointness is a direct table check.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Dedicated, protected, hardened Administrative Workstations
groups.prior_reason: The counted application establishes that a four-state guest-use experiment ends unused and powered off. Its induction adds little to checking those four observed states and the shutdown test.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Management transport protection and local exceptions
groups.prior_reason: The current contribution reads TLS 1.3 from 14 sessions. A negotiated-session checker establishes the same observation.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Administrator authentication and individual credentials
groups.prior_reason: Authentication must precede each admitted administrative operation and bind to the correct session and principal. The reusable admission argument is valuable across request sequences.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check individual accounts and bind administrative operations to authenticated sessions where management is deployed.

groups.title: Authorized provisioning and initial certificate requests
groups.prior_reason: The counted proof compares saved CSR/sign/load paths, authority membership, and event order for four runs. A structured trace checker can establish those finite relationships directly.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Personnel clearance and Outer administration
groups.prior_reason: Clearance is an authoritative personnel fact. An emulated account or certificate role cannot establish a person's clearance.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: SIEM placement, collection, alerting, and log transport
groups.prior_reason: No implemented SIEM-to-event-to-alert relationship is established. Product integration tests and operational observation should establish the basic collection and alerting functions first.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Cross Domain Solution approval conditions
groups.prior_reason: The stated claim requires official CDS approval and registration. A relay implementation or theorem cannot confer those statuses.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Physical protection, authorized access, and disposal
groups.prior_reason: Facility access, classification of physical protection, and disposal are physical and organizational controls absent from the model.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Parallel Inner components and distinct Outer internal interfaces
groups.prior_reason: The selected result supplies one firewall-compatible branch from each Inner to its Outer. Checking explicit paths or running graph reachability directly establishes that existence claim.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Interoperable components across communicating sites
groups.prior_reason: The current result reuses a general argument that mixed encapsulation and encryption preserve the original Ethernet header. That argument can cover modeled executions beyond a successful probe.
groups.new_validation_claim: Test each required Inner and Outer tunnel in both directions on the selected devices and record the recovered payload.

groups.title: Firewall requirements when combining capability packages
groups.prior_reason: The current setup has no selected companion CP with its applicable mandatory clauses. The immediate missing work is determining the combined requirements.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Approved physical paths out of Red Networks
groups.prior_reason: A single unprotected egress path can defeat the design. The useful structural claim covers every observed Red-to-outside path.
groups.new_validation_claim: Check Red exits against conforming solutions or recorded approvals for data-in-transit protection.

groups.title: Operational security updates and TEMPEST policy
groups.prior_reason: The claimed duties depend on an actual update process and external policy, including TEMPEST requirements. Version strings and fabricated update events cannot establish them.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Hardware inventory and available baseline configuration
groups.prior_reason: The counted application shows that one successful response contains a selected configuration fragment. Direct response-to-source comparison establishes that observation.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Procurement documentation excludes classified-protection purpose
groups.prior_reason: Procurement-document content needs an authentic document set and review for prohibited disclosures. The central difficulty is document coverage and meaning.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Annual and NSA-authorized compliance audits
groups.prior_reason: Annual audits, cooperation, and AO review are actions by organizations. They require genuine audit and delivery records.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Registration, approval, annual renewal, and version updates
groups.prior_reason: Registration, renewal, and version-transition compliance require authority-issued records and a documented deadline interpretation.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Audit retention, storage monitoring, backup, and continuity
groups.prior_reason: The current proof covers a frozen copy's interval coverage and equality across one observed restart. A complete byte/range comparison and a restart test address that bounded observation directly.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Infrastructure authentication alternatives
groups.prior_reason: The current setup lacks the relevant infrastructure authentication and entropy evidence. The password alternative cannot be established by merely measuring string length.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Incident triggers, required report fields, and reporting deadline
groups.prior_reason: Actual incident classification, notification, and receipt within a deadline require operational records and human decisions.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Separation of administrative and auditing personnel
groups.prior_reason: Different roles or credentials do not establish different people. The required separation relies on an authenticated personnel-to-role mapping.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Personnel training and physical tamper inspections
groups.prior_reason: Training and physical inspections are real-world events. Their occurrence and adequacy are not network-state properties.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Revocation or CAK destruction before disposal
groups.prior_reason: The current record has revocation tests but no disposal event. A before-disposal requirement needs authentic linked lifecycle events.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Security Administrator operational duties
groups.prior_reason: The counted contribution reuses a successful configuration readback as evidence of administrator monitoring. It establishes a narrow response fact, not the administrator's continuing duties.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Auditor review duties and access boundary
groups.prior_reason: The counted application checks that eight previously read events remain an exact prefix after one observed rotation. A direct ordered-content comparison can establish that fact.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Optional Integrator involvement and duty scope
groups.prior_reason: Integrator engagement and personnel duties require an actual engagement and its applicable responsibilities. An unselected optional branch establishes no substantive requirement.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: AO authorization evidence and lifecycle control
groups.prior_reason: AO authorization and lifecycle acceptance are authoritative acts. Their existence cannot be inferred from a network model.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Whole-solution testing and preserved results
groups.prior_reason: The counted proof establishes that each of 12 test IDs maps to a nonempty saved path. A manifest/file checker is the direct tool for completeness and retained content.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Objective software and firmware signing algorithms
groups.prior_reason: The signed demonstration utility is not bound to deployed Solution Component software. The useful first task is obtaining the actual artifacts and signature-verification evidence.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: Redundant component and load-balancing permission
groups.prior_reason: Additional redundant paths can introduce a firewall bypass. The selected deployment is a useful second application of the same all-path separation theorem.
groups.new_validation_claim: List redundant devices, apply the duties for their roles and rerun the selected path and packet checks on the expanded network.

groups.title: Optional additional controls and screening-router scope
groups.prior_reason: The source permits the described additions without imposing a countable security obligation on them. A theorem should not be manufactured from that permission.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.

groups.title: CP user legal undertaking and disclaimer
groups.prior_reason: Legal undertaking and acceptance are outside the network model and require responsible legal/organizational review.
groups.new_validation_claim: The retained assessment and reason are recorded in specs/proof_scope.json.
